GrupLokal.Name: docker-users
GrupLokal.Description: Members of this group can access features exposed by the Docker Desktop service (such as Windows Containers and the Hyper-V backend).

GrupLokal.Name: Access Control Assistance Operators
GrupLokal.Description: Members of this group can remotely query authorization attributes and permissions for resources on this computer.

GrupLokal.Name: Administrators
GrupLokal.Description: Administrators have complete and unrestricted access to the computer/domain

GrupLokal.Name: Backup Operators
GrupLokal.Description: Backup Operators can override security restrictions for the sole purpose of backing up or restoring files

GrupLokal.Name: Cryptographic Operators
GrupLokal.Description: Members are authorized to perform cryptographic operations.

GrupLokal.Name: Device Owners
GrupLokal.Description: Members of this group can change system-wide settings.

GrupLokal.Name: Distributed COM Users
GrupLokal.Description: Members are allowed to launch, activate and use Distributed COM objects on this machine.

GrupLokal.Name: Event Log Readers
GrupLokal.Description: Members of this group can read event logs from local machine

GrupLokal.Name: Guests
GrupLokal.Description: Guests have the same access as members of the Users group by default, except for the Guest account which is further restricted

GrupLokal.Name: Hyper-V Administrators
GrupLokal.Description: Members of this group have complete and unrestricted access to all features of Hyper-V.

GrupLokal.Name: IIS_IUSRS
GrupLokal.Description: Built-in group used by Internet Information Services.

GrupLokal.Name: Network Configuration Operators
GrupLokal.Description: Members in this group can have some administrative privileges to manage configuration of networking features

GrupLokal.Name: Performance Log Users
GrupLokal.Description: Members of this group may schedule logging of performance counters, enable trace providers, and collect event traces both locally and via remote access to this computer

GrupLokal.Name: Performance Monitor Users
GrupLokal.Description: Members of this group can access performance counter data locally and remotely

GrupLokal.Name: Power Users
GrupLokal.Description: Power Users are included for backwards compatibility and possess limited administrative powers

GrupLokal.Name: Remote Desktop Users
GrupLokal.Description: Members in this group are granted the right to logon remotely

GrupLokal.Name: Remote Management Users
GrupLokal.Description: Members of this group can access WMI resources over management protocols (such as WS-Management via the Windows Remote Management service). This applies only to WMI namespaces that grant access to the user.

GrupLokal.Name: Replicator
GrupLokal.Description: Supports file replication in a domain

GrupLokal.Name: System Managed Accounts Group
GrupLokal.Description: Members of this group are managed by the system.

GrupLokal.Name: Users
GrupLokal.Description: Users are prevented from making accidental or intentional system-wide changes and can run most applications
